OCTOBER 1942 - "Three Southern Junior Championships have been won during the season, Michael Broadbent successfully annexing both the 100 and 220 yards and Willie Nankeville winning the half-mile event.

A large crowd had gathered at the Polytechnic Stadium; and it is certain that many went away sure that the Belgrave dual sprint Champion, Michael Broadbent, was destined for still higher honours in the future.
